DelegatedAuthorityGrant.description:
Scoped authority delegated to this principal for another principal's work.

Delegated authority is part of the native AIP identity model. It lets a
runtime distinguish "can read or operate on my own work" from "can read or
operate on work owned by a specific principal" without granting broad
`*:any` scopes. Compatibility profiles may project this from their own
auth systems, but the resulting grant is evaluated by AIP core/runtime
semantics.

principal_id.description: Principal whose work is covered by the grant.

scopes.description: Granted scope labels. `*` grants all scopes for this principal.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp. Expired grants MUST be ignored by runtimes.

reason.description: Optional reason or authority reference retained for audit/debugging.

ApprovalRule.description:
Composable approval authority expression.

Leaf predicates are evaluated only against authority memberships returned
by a trusted resolver. Values carried in an action or decision payload are
never sufficient to satisfy a predicate.

oneOf.description: Every child expression must be satisfied.

allow_decision_reuse.description: Explicitly permits one verified decision to satisfy more than one child.

oneOf.description: At least one child expression must be satisfied.
At least `required` distinct matching decisions must be present.

rules.description: Expressions that can contribute to the quorum.

distinct_principals.description: Whether one principal may contribute at most one vote.

oneOf.description: A member of a trusted role must approve.

A verified external approval system must approve.
A non-revoked delegated authority grant must match the operation.

max_risk.description: Maximum accepted risk for this grant.

ApprovalEvidencePayload.description:
Immutable governed action payload exported for an approval decision.

Runtimes derive this view from the durable queued action. It is never copied
into the approval request, receipts, audit events, callbacks, or ordinary
read responses. `input_hash` uses the same canonical hash represented by an
approval request's `input_snapshot` evidence artifact.

input_hash.description: Canonical SHA-256 hash covering capability, input, and transaction.

input.description: Exact action input supplied to the governed capability.

transaction.description: Transaction context, including plan binding, when present.

identity.description: Trusted identity context resolved for the governed action.

plan_id.description: Plan id produced by a previous planning action.

oneOf.description: Reconcile a provider operation whose commit outcome is unknown.
Explicit state for operations that cannot roll back.
